dishes.name: Antwerpse handjes
dishes.desc: Small butter biscuits shaped like a hand, named after the legend of Brabo throwing a giant's hand into the Scheldt. Sold in bakeries and chocolate shops, also as chocolates.

dishes.name: Worstenbroodje
dishes.desc: Spiced minced pork baked in a flaky puff-pastry roll. A bakery staple in Antwerp, eaten warm at any hour.

dishes.name: Filet américain
dishes.desc: Seasoned raw minced beef spread on a baguette or pistolet, a lunch of the Antwerp sandwich bars. It is a Belgian staple with a strong local following.

dishes.name: Mechelse koekoek
dishes.desc: Slow-cooked chicken from Mechelen in the Antwerp province, served in a creamy sauce with mushrooms or in classic Flemish stews. A prized local poultry breed.

dishes.name: Frietjes with stoofvlees
dishes.desc: Thick-cut twice-fried chips from a frietkot, here eaten with sweet-sour beef stew or sauce. Antwerp is known for its old fry shops.
